property_summary: Once the contract is initialized, SetMinSum must not modify MinSum (it reverts leaving state untouched); the mutant sets MinSum even on the reverting path, so MinSum changes.

For any input, a call to SetMinSum that reverts must leave MinSum unchanged; the mutant writes MinSum=_val before the initialized check, so on an initialized contract a reverting SetMinSum(v) still changes MinSum.

Once the contract is initialized, SetMinSum(_val) must revert and leave MinSum exactly as it was; the mutant writes MinSum=_val before the initialized check, so a reverting SetMinSum still mutates MinSum for some fuzzed value.

For any fuzzed value, calling SetMinSum on an already-initialized contract must revert and leave MinSum unchanged; the mutant assigns MinSum before the check, so the reverting call still mutates MinSum.

Once the contract is initialized, any SetMinSum call must revert without altering MinSum: the reference leaves MinSum at its pre-call value, while the mutant writes MinSum=_val during the reverting call, so MinSum changes for some fuzzed value.

For any caller with no code and any log address, SetLogFile must succeed and store the given log address; the mutant instead reverts because Log(msg.sender) fails the extcodesize check on an EOA caller.

For any caller and any log address distinct from that caller, calling SetLogFile(log) must store exactly log in LogFile(); the mutant instead stores msg.sender, so a contract caller passing a different log address breaks the rule.
